description: Observations from a FAOSTAT domain — the actual numbers, with units, year and data-quality flag. AUTHORITATIVE for "how much <crop> did <country> produce in <year>", world agricultural trade flows, fertiliser and pesticide use, agricultural emissions and food-balance data. Pass codes from faostat_dimensions: area (country), element (what is measured) and item (the commodity) are all numeric domain-specific codes, not names. Example: domain "QCL", area "231" (United States of America), element "5510" (production quantity), item "15" (wheat), years "2020,2021,2022". Answers keylessly from a stored copy of FAO's bulk files for QCL (crops and livestock production), FBS (food balances 2010-), PP (producer prices, annual) and RL (land use), read one country or one commodity at a time (give area, or item without area to compare countries; names are accepted as well as codes; `sort: "value_desc"` ranks). Each answer says answered_from stored_copy, carries FAO's data date and the FAO attribution, and omits figures FAO flags X (from an external organization). Other domains need `_apiKey` for FAO's account-gated live API.

_apiKey.description: Optional. A FAOSTAT access token, or "email:password" for a FAOSTAT account: sends the call live to FAO's account-gated query API (any domain). Without it the call is answered from the stored copy of QCL, FBS, PP and RL.

area.description: One or more FAOSTAT area codes, comma-separated, e.g. "231" or "231,68,100". From faostat_dimensions dimension "area".

domain_code.description: FAOSTAT domain code, e.g. "QCL". From faostat_domains.

element.description: One or more element codes, comma-separated, e.g. "5510" (production quantity). From faostat_dimensions dimension "element".

include_aggregates.description: Stored copy only: with sort "value_desc" and no area, regional and world aggregates (area codes 5000+) are left out unless this is true.

item.description: One or more item codes, comma-separated, e.g. "15" (wheat). From faostat_dimensions dimension "item".

sort.description: Stored copy only: "value_desc" returns the largest values first (e.g. top producers of one item in one year).

year.description: One or more years, comma-separated, e.g. "2022" or "2018,2019,2020,2021,2022". Omit for every year the domain holds.

name: faostat_data
title: Faostat Data
